question:
Identify the option that rectifies the spelling of the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The fencing was adoned with ornamental plants of various colours.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"adoned"** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling is **"adorned"**. (सजाया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** The bride's hair was **adorned **with beautiful flowers.
 
 
 
• **"Adorned"** means to decorate or add beauty to something. (सजाना)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Variouse** (विभिन्न): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Various"**.

 
 
• **Example:** The shop offers **various **types of chocolates.
 
 
 
• **Fensing** (बाड़ लगाना): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Fencing"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The **fencing **around the garden keeps the animals out.
 
 
 
• **Ornamenntal** (सजावटी): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"Ornamental"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The **ornamental **plants added a touch of elegance to the garden.
